newsitem.title: JAPAN: Jusco 6-mth parent current profit seen up - paper.
newsitem.headline: Jusco 6-mth parent current profit seen up - paper.

text.p: The parent current profit of supermarket operator Jusco Co Ltd in the six months to August 31, 1996 is expected to be 12.5 billion yen, up 18 percent from the same period a year ago, a Japanese newspaper reported on Thursday.
The business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said it expected an increase in Jusco's profit largely because of the company's cost-cutting and an estimated rise in sales due to the opening of new outlets.
Company spokesmen were not immediately available for comment on the Nihon Keizai report.
